cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shared car log has three blanks after nine: mileage, fuel and driver. Read them in order, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I mean the whole row. Start with mileage; don't substitute a damage report for the log.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Driver I remember. The rest means six flights down to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book. Keep your place at mileage; we aren't skipping an entry because the stairs are inconvenient.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 full-row correction and A5 retrieval offer preserve concealed driver interest through complete professional records.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 says missing mileage and fuel require the glovebox book, but A1 calls those entries blank in the shared log and does not identify a separate data source.

relationship.evidence: B2 suspects a damage inquiry and B4 avoids a six-flight trip, credible priorities.

heightening.evidence: A5 accepts the inconvenient trip to maintain full-record appearance, a useful response to B4.

specificity.evidence: A1 shared log blanks and B4 glovebox book create uncertainty about where absent readings will come from.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 is direct and purposeful; the issue is source clarity rather than length.
